outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map combined with western blot images (IP efficiency test), not a plot of averaged data.

Bar charts show % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance per antibody derived from densitometry of the single representative blots shown in panel A. There is no indication of replicate averaging (no error bars, no stated n), so these appear to be single measurements per antibody rather than averages requiring individual data points.
Heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Violin plots already display the full distribution of the data, so individual points are not required.
Bar chart of mean ± SD (n=4) with individual data points (dots) overlaid for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 abundances.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure (AlphaFold model), not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plots comparing log2 enrichment ratios between conditions; individual points are inherently the data shown, so this is exempt.
Scatter plot of log10 abundances for HTT vs HAP40 across individual IP-MS experiments; scatter plots are exempt.
PCA scatter plot; individual points (samples) are already displayed, exempt from the requirement.
PCA scatter plots stratified by tissue; individual points (samples) are already displayed, exempt from the requirement.
